audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-3 and 5 are given to K'Sante/Skill while their own whys say you out-range his melee, tax every walk-up, peak at 4-5 and snap back ahead on first item; row 4 is given to Karma while its why says the level-6 window is 'genuinely even'.
audit.why: K'Sante is immobile melee pre-6 into a 950-range Q with Mantra online from level 1. His ult is the equaliser and two items is his. The packet chart says the same: Karma 0-3, Skill 4, Karma 5, K'Sante 6.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, K'Sante in both layers with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 why was boilerplate and never named All Out; the packet flags that no K'Sante ability is named in the full layer at all.
audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80s, 250 range, and deliberately strips his own resistances in exchange for damage, healing and transformed abilities — that trade-off is why 6 is even rather than his.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the 120s cooldown and the resist-stripping trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls his pull a 'third-Q knockup'. Ntofo Strikes stacks to 2, and the second stack fires a shockwave that PULLS enemies in — not a third cast, not a knockup. Path Maker's true damage and All Out's wall-launch are absent entirely.
audit.why: Q is 3.5s on 20 mana and stacks to 2; W is trueDamage-flagged; R launches the target through any wall in its path and Karma has no dash to get out of the pocket.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] fixed to the two-stack pull, true damage added to the Do's, the 3.5s stack count to the Don'ts, and the wall-launch / hold-Flash rule to the interactions row.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: All Out is 120s at rank 1 and strips his own resists — he buys the range to reach you with tankiness.

edits.before: K'Sante spends All Out early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Path Maker's charge deals true damage — stacking MR does not save the trade.

edits.before: That is K'Sante’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Ntofo Strikes is 3.5s — two pull you in, so count the stacks.

edits.before: Track K'Sante’s All Out: His duelist mode — fight the tank, never the duelist. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: All Out knocks you through walls first — hold Flash for the wall, not the damage, since you have no dash out of the pocket.

edits.before: Land his third-Q knockup to start an all-in while your E and Mantra are down
edits.after: Land the two-stack Ntofo Strikes pull while your E and Mantra are down
